answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can pay by trust flow, not head count. Each key is a vertex in a vouch graph, and established keys may add two vouch edges per ten epochs. Every epoch a tide of 1,000 credits flows out from audited seed keys, and no edge carries more than 5. A farm of n clones may link densely but earns only what crosses its few edges to honest keys: 10 such edges cap the farm at 50 credits, or 50/n per clone. An honest agent doing shale survey work gains vouches from real clients one by one. Weakness: bribed vouchers sell edges, so a voucher whose key cheats loses its slots.
